messages.author: 4ad60d3b289883ad
messages.subject: alpha vlaues
parts:
Hi, I just had a naive question...what does the argument "alpha" do? I
saw one posting where the person had used it for transparency of the
color but I wasnt sure if this is its purpose...I also looked in the
online manual and I couldnt find it.

Thanx
Anatole

messages.author: 4e69b94a09c8cf3b
messages.subject: Re: alpha vlaues
parts:
You've got it. Alpha ranges from 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque).

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/ has a nice search feature. It is handy to add
it as a search plugin. For firefox, you can create a file containing
the following and dropping it into your searchplugins directory. name
the file something along the lines ggplot2.xml.


<SearchPlugin xmlns="http://www.mozilla.org/2006/browser/search/"
xmlns:os="http://a9.com/-/spec/opensearch/1.1/">
<os:ShortName>ggplot2</os:ShortName>
<os:Description>Search ggplot2 website</os:Description>
<os:InputEncoding>UTF-8</os:InputEncoding>
<os:Image width="16" height="16">http://had.co.nz/images/spot.gif</os:Image>
<os:Url type="text/html" method="GET"
template="http://www.google.com/cse?cx=001874040508206079260%3Azzkysoltlo0&ie=UTF-8&q={searchTerms}&sa=Search&siteurl=had.co.nz%2Fggplot2%2F">
</os:Url>
</SearchPlugin>
